rows.note: Use 例子 as the all-purpose noun for one example or occurrence illustrating a general pattern.

example.english: This is a very common instance.
example.traditional: 呢個係一個好常見嘅例子。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 soeng4 gin3 ge3 lai6 zi2

rows.note: Use 個案 when the instance is a particular case considered separately, especially in medical, legal, or problem-solving contexts.

example.english: The doctor said this was a rare instance.
example.traditional: 醫生話呢個係一宗罕見個案。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 zung1 hon2 gin3 go3 on3
